findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 484 current-evidence audit: The Power to Overcome is a 500-Ki universal CaC Awoken Skill from Future Saga Chapter 4, unlocked by completing Quest 31, Ultimate All-Out Showdown. Current evidence supports a first stage with about +20% damage reduction and +5% movement speed, below-50%-health regeneration, and an unblockable sword-grab replacement. Re-input activates an approximately 12-second Unleashed stage with very rapid/infinite-style Ki regeneration, +15% basic attack damage, +30% Strike/Ki Super damage, +10% movement speed, and HP drain. Community measurements conflict on some exact values/cooldowns, so those remain source-bounded.
